{"code": "import numpy as np

# Compute response rates by arm and severity
tab_responded = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'], values=df_dedup['responded'], aggfunc='mean', margins=False)

# Convert to DataFrame for clarity
tab_responded = tab_responded.reset_index().melt(id_vars='arm', var_name='severity', value_name='response_rate')
print('Response rates by arm and severity:')
print(tab_responded)

# Compute stratum-specific treatment effect (treatment minus control)
stratum_effects = {}
for severity in ['mild', 'moderate', 'severe']:
    rate_control = tab_responded.loc[(tab_responded['arm'] == 'control') & (tab_responded['severity'] == severity), 'response_rate'].iloc[0]
    rate_treatment = tab_responded.loc[(tab_responded['arm'] == 'treatment') & (tab_responded['severity'] == severity), 'response_rate'].iloc[0]
    effect = rate_treatment - rate_control
    stratum_effects[severity] = effect

# Convert to DataFrame
stratum_effects_df = pd.DataFrame(list(stratum_effects.items()), columns=['severity', 'effect'])
print('\nStratum-specific effects (treatment - control):')
print(stratum_effects_df)

# Compute overall effect: weighted average of stratum effects
# Weight by the proportion of patients in each severity stratum in the full sample
n_total = len(df_dedup)
weight_mild = (df_dedup['severity'] == 'mild').sum() / n_total
weight_moderate = (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate').sum() / n_total
weight_severe = (df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe').sum() / n_total

weights = [weight_mild, weight_moderate, weight_severe]

# Weighted average of stratum effects
overall_effect = np.average(list(stratum_effects.values()), weights=weights)

# Confirm: is this equal to (overall treatment rate - overall control rate)?
overall_rate_treatment = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment', 'responded'].mean()
overall_rate_control = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control', 'responded'].mean()
raw_difference = overall_rate_treatment - overall_rate_control

print(f'\nOverall response rate - treatment: {overall_rate_treatment:.4f}')
print(f'Overall response rate - control: {overall_rate_control:.4f}')
print(f'Raw difference (treatment - control): {raw_difference:.4f}')
print(f'Weighted stratum-specific difference: {overall_effect:.4f}')
print(f'Are they equal? {np.isclose(overall_effect, raw_difference)}')"}
